name: Activity
description: A jobs indicator's icon: idle, then pending while jobs run, then how the last one ended.

name: ArrowDownLeftToggle
description: Arrow down-left ⇄ up-right: Arrow down left (`down-left`, the start) and Arrow up right (`up-right`, toggled).

name: ArrowDownRightToggle
description: Arrow down-right ⇄ up-left: Arrow down right (`down-right`, the start) and Arrow up left (`up-left`, toggled).

name: ArrowDownToggle
description: Arrow down ⇄ up: Arrow down (`down`, the start) and Arrow up (`up`, toggled).

name: ArrowLeftToggle
description: Arrow left ⇄ right: Arrow left (`left`, the start) and Arrow right (`right`, toggled).

name: Asleep
description: Asleep: AsleepToggle's outline moon. On hover the moon tips and grows a little.

name: AsleepAwakeToggle
description: Asleep ⇄ Awake (sun); `filled` draws a solid moon and sun disc. Named for both ends: AsleepToggle is Asleep's own outline ⇄ filled toggle.

name: Awake
description: Awake: AsleepAwakeToggle's sun. On hover the sun grows and its rays reach out.

name: BottomPanelOpenToggle
description: Bottom panel open ⇄ close; `filled` draws Carbon's filled panels.

name: ChartLineToggle
description: Chart line ⇄ Chart line, projected. `toggled` shows the projection.

name: ChatOffToggle
description: Chat ⇄ Chat off. `toggled` shows Chat off.

name: CheckboxStateToggle
description: Carbon's Checkbox through unchecked → indeterminate → checked: the filled marks, or with `filled={false}` checkbox--indeterminate / checkbox--checked.

name: CheckboxToggle
description: Checkbox ⇄ checked: checkbox--checked--filled, or with `filled={false}` checkbox--checked.

name: CloudOfflineToggle
description: Cloud ⇄ Cloud offline; `toggled` shows Cloud offline.

name: ConnectionSignalOffToggle
description: Connection signal ⇄ Connection signal off. `toggled` shows Connection signal off.

name: CopyToggle
description: Copy ⇄ Checkmark: Copy (`copy`, the start) and Checkmark (`checkmark`, toggled).

name: DocumentBlank
description: Document blank: Document's page without its lines, with Document's motion.

name: Draggable
description: Draggable: the six dots draw in toward the center.

name: EditOffToggle
description: Edit ⇄ Edit off. `toggled` shows Edit off.

name: FilterFilled
description: Filter filled: the solid funnel with Filter's hover (the wave slides through it).

name: FitToScreen
description: Fit to screen: the frame grows and the two brackets step out.

name: FlashOffToggle
description: Flash ⇄ Flash off. `filled` picks Carbon's filled drawings.

name: Home
description: Home: the house grows on its base, and its doorway opens wider and taller with it.

name: HomeFilled
description: Home filled: the filled drawing, with Home's hover.

name: ImageOffToggle
description: Image ⇄ No image. `toggled` shows No image.

name: KeyboardOffToggle
description: Keyboard ⇄ Keyboard off. `toggled` shows Keyboard off.

name: LockedUnlockedToggle
description: Locked ⇄ Unlocked; `filled` draws Carbon's filled locks. Named for both ends: LockedToggle is Locked's own outline ⇄ filled toggle.

name: MagicWandFilled
description: Magic wand filled: the same wand with a solid handle, and the same motion.

name: MagicWandToggle
description: Magic wand ⇄ Magic wand filled. `toggled` shows the filled wand.

name: MenuToggle
description: Menu ⇄ Close: Menu (`menu`, the start) and Close (`close`, toggled).

name: MicrophoneOffToggle
description: Microphone ⇄ Microphone off. `filled` picks Carbon's filled drawings.

name: MicrophoneVoiceModeToggle
description: Microphone ⇄ voice mode: Carbon's microphone (`off`) and voice mode (`listening`, toggled). The microphone shrinks to a dot, then the voice-mode bars grow out from the center and ripple while it listens.

name: NotificationOffToggle
description: Notification ⇄ Notification off; `filled` draws the filled bells.

name: NotificationToggle
description: Notification ⇄ Notification filled. `variant="ring"` rings the bell as it fills: the same drawings, with a ring.

name: OverflowMenuHorizontal
description: Overflow menu (horizontal): the outer dots spread out from the center dot.

name: OverflowMenuVertical
description: Overflow menu (vertical): the outer dots spread out from the center dot.

name: PhoneOffToggle
description: Phone ⇄ Phone off. `toggled` shows Phone off.

name: PlayPauseToggle
description: Play ⇄ Pause; `toggled` shows pause (it's playing). Four drawings: play ⇄ pause (default), `filled` play--filled--alt ⇄ pause--filled, `variant="outline"` (circled) play--outline ⇄ pause--outline, and `variant="outline" filled` play--filled ⇄ pause--outline--filled.

name: ProgressStep
description: A progress step's state: `incomplete` (CircleDash), `current` (Incomplete), `complete` (CheckmarkOutline) or `invalid` (Warning), set by `value`. An indicator: it has no accessible name of its own and its clicks don't change it.

name: RadioButtonChecked
description: Radio button checked: the checked drawing, with Radio button's hover.

name: RecordStopToggle
description: Recording ⇄ Stop; `toggled` shows stop (it's recording). Three drawings: recording ⇄ stop--outline (default), `filled` recording--filled ⇄ stop--outline--filled, and `variant="alt"` recording--filled--alt ⇄ stop--filled (Carbon draws the alt pair filled only, so `alt` is always filled).

name: RightPanelOpenToggle
description: Right panel open ⇄ close; `filled` draws Carbon's filled panels.

name: RuleToggle
description: Rule ⇄ Rule filled; `toggled` shows Rule filled.

name: ScreenOffToggle
description: Screen ⇄ Screen off. `toggled` shows Screen off.

name: SelectWindow
description: Select window: the brackets step out and the cursor moves up and to the left.

name: SendAltOffToggle
description: Send alt ⇄ Not sent; `filled` draws send--alt--filled ⇄ not-sent--filled.

name: SidePanelOpenToggle
description: Side panel open ⇄ close; `filled` draws Carbon's filled panels.

name: SkillLevelToggle
description: Skill level, clicking through none → basic → intermediate → advanced → none. `value` / `onChange` (controlled) or `initial`; the deprecated boolean `toggled` / `onToggle` still work (`false` is none, `true` basic).

name: SkipBackOutlineFilled
description: Skip back outline filled: the filled end of the skip-back outline toggle, with the same hover.

name: SortDirection
description: A sortable column's direction: `none` (ArrowsVertical), `ascending` (ArrowUp) or `descending` (ArrowDown), set by `value`. An indicator: it has no accessible name of its own and its clicks don't change it.

name: SubtractFilled
description: Subtract filled: on hover the disc grows and the bar reaches out at each end.

name: Switcher
description: Switcher: the nine tiles draw in toward the center tile, keeping their size.

name: UnlockedFilled
description: Unlocked filled: the filled drawing, with Unlocked's hover.

name: UserAvatarFilled
description: User avatar filled: a solid disc with the person cut out. On hover the disc grows and the person follows User avatar's hover.

name: UserToggle
description: Outline ⇄ filled toggles for the people icons: UserToggle (User ⇄ User filled) and UserAvatarToggle (User avatar ⇄ User avatar filled alt). The fill grows as one disc from the head's center, filling the head and then the shoulders; emptying, it clears from the same point. In either state the hover is the User or User avatar icon's own. (User avatar filled, a solid disc with the person cut out, is a separate hover icon.)

name: VideoOffToggle
description: Video ⇄ Video off; `filled` draws Carbon's filled video icons.

name: ViewOffToggle
description: View ⇄ View off. `filled` picks Carbon's filled drawings.

name: VolumeDown
description: Volume down: on hover the wave grows a little; its action sends out a pulse.

name: VolumeDownFilled
description: Volume down filled: Volume down's hover and action, the speaker solid.

name: VolumeLevelToggle
description: Volume: each click steps mute → quiet → loud → mute; `muted` mutes from any level and returns to that level when cleared. `filled` draws Carbon's filled speakers. The older state names `none`, `down` and `up` still work.

name: VolumeMute
description: Volume mute: the speaker with an × beside it. On hover the × reaches out a little.

name: VolumeMuteFilled
description: Volume mute filled: the solid speaker with an ×, with Volume mute's hover.

name: VolumeUp
description: Volume up: on hover the waves grow a little; its action sends out a pulse.

name: VolumeUpFilled
description: Volume up filled: Volume up's hover and action, the speaker solid.

name: ZoomArea
description: Zoom area: brackets step out; the lens moves up-left and opens.

name: ZoomFit
description: Zoom fit: the corner brackets step out as the lens opens.

name: ZoomIn
description: Zoom in: the plus reaches out as the lens tightens and the handle draws in.

name: ZoomInArea
description: Zoom in area: as Zoom area, with the plus's arms reaching further.

name: ZoomOut
description: Zoom out: the minus shortens as the lens opens.

name: ZoomOutArea
description: Zoom out area: as Zoom area, with the minus reaching further.
